draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The claim references noise-perturbation experiments (10%, 20%, 30% noise with drops 0.6, 1.3, 1.8) and table T2, but the research package contains only exp1 (original labels) and Table T1. No label-noise experiments or T2 exist in the supplied evidence, so the claim has no support.
